## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for the covered acceptance criteria pass
- [ ] `docs/miembros/<me>/bitacora.md` and `estado.md` updated; task marked in `docs/tareas/<me>.md`
- [ ] No keys, tokens, receipts or personal data in the diff
- [ ] If M1 §3 or M2a §7 changed: both sections changed together and the other member approved
- [ ] Moves funds or signs (contracts, verifier, relayer) → reviewed by Alexxe; touches personal data → reviewed by Maximiliano
- [ ] Testnet only; nothing simulated is presented as an on-chain guarantee
